items.markdown:
![Noodles with Fish Curry | Khanom Jeen Nam Ya | ขนมจีนน้ำยา ...](https://api.dataforseo.com/cdn/i/07280719-1672-0139-0000-33faabb86670:4)
Khanom jeen nam ya is `a popular Thai dish featuring soft rice noodles topped with a rich, aromatic fish and coconut milk curry, served alongside fresh crunchy vegetables`.[](https://hot-thai-kitchen.com/kanom-jeen-namya/) [[1]](https://hot-thai-kitchen.com/kanom-jeen-namya/)[[2]](https://hungryinthailand.com/kanom-jeen-nam-ya/)

Key Components

- **Noodles (Khanom Jeen):** Fresh or dried fermented round rice noodles.
- **The Sauce (Nam Ya):** A thick, savory curry made by boiling fish and herbs, blending them together, and simmering with coconut milk.
- **Crucial Herbs:** Fingerroot (krachai), lemongrass, galangal, and kaffir lime leaves give the dish its unique fragrance.
- **Fresh Veggies:** Eaten with cucumber slices, long beans, bean sprouts, basil, and cabbage to balance the rich curry.[](https://hot-thai-kitchen.com/kanom-jeen-namya/) [[1]](https://support.google.com/knowledgepanel/answer/9787176)[[2]](https://www.seriouseats.com/kanom-jeen-nam-ya-thai-fish-curry-rice-noodles-5199040)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/JOHG6FUzwDQ?vl=en)[[4]](https://www.thai-food-online.co.uk/pages/kanom-jeen-namya-recipe)

If you would like, I can share a **full step-by-step recipe** or suggest **substitutes** for hard-to-find Thai ingredients.
